# Draft:Timeline of the 2023 Pacific typhoon season

Timeline of events
April
April 11
* 21:00 UTC at PAGASA reports the formation of a tropical depression from a low-pressure area, giving it the name Amang with an estimated central pressure of .
April 13
* 03:00 UTC at PAGASA reports the weakening of Amang into a low-pressure area, estimating a central pressure of .
April 19
* 00:00 UTC at The JMA reports the formation of a tropical depression from a disturbance.
* 12:00 UTC at The JTWC starts tracking the first tropical depression, naming it One.
April 20
* 00:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Tropical Depression One intensified into a tropical storm.
* 12:00 UTC at  – The JMA reports the intensification of the tropical depression into a tropical storm, giving it the name Sanvu.
* 18:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Tropical Storm Sanvu (One) has reached its peak intensity, estimating maximum sustained winds of  and a minimum barometric pressure of  six hours later.
April 21
* 06:00 UTC at The JMA reports that Tropical Storm Sanvu (One0 has reached its peak intensity, estimating winds of  and a barometric pressure of .
* 18:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Tropical Storm Sanvu (One) has weakened into a tropical depression.
April 22
* 00:00 UTC at The JMA reports that Tropical Storm Sanvu (One) has weakened into a tropical depression.
* 06:00 UTC at The JMA last notes Tropical Depression Sanvu (One); it dissipates six hours later.
* 12:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Tropical Depression Sanvu (One) has weakened into a tropical disturbance.
May
May 19
* 18:00 UTC at The JMA reports the formation of the first tropical depression of the month from a disturbance.
May 20
* 00:00 UTC at The JTWC starts tracking a tropical depression, naming it Two.
* 12:00 UTC at The JMA reports that Tropical Depression Two has intensified into a tropical storm, assigning it the name Mawar.
* 12:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Tropical Depression Two has intensified into a tropical storm.
May 21
* 00:00 UTC at The JMA reports that Tropical Storm Mawar (Two) has intensified into a severe tropical storm.
* 12:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Tropical Storm Mawar (Two) has intensified into a Category 1-equivalent typhoon on the Saffir–Simpson hurricane wind scale (SSHWS).
* 18:00 UTC at The JMA reports that Severe Tropical Storm Mawar (Two) has intensified into a typhoon.
May 22
* 00:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Typhoon Mawar (Two) has intensified into a Category 2-equivalent typhoon on the SSHWS.
* 18:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Typhoon Mawar (Two) has intensified into a Category 3-equivalent typhoon on the SSHWS.
May 23
* 00:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Typhoon Mawar (Two) has intensified into a Category 4-equivalent typhoon on the SSHWS.
* 06:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Typhoon Mawar (Two) has intensified into a Category 5-equivalent typhoon on the SSHWS.
* 18:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Super Typhoon Mawar (Two) has weakened into a Category 4-equivalent typhoon on the SSHWS.
May 24
* 00:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Super Typhoon Mawar (Two) has weakened into a Category 3-equivalent typhoon on the SSHWS.
* 06:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Typhoon Mawar (Two) has intensified into a Category 4-equivalent typhoon on the SSHWS.
May 25
* 00:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Typhoon Mawar (Two) has intensified into a Category 5-equivalent typhoon on the SSHWS.
* 12:00 UTC at The JMA reports that Super Typhoon Mawar (Two) has reached its peak intensity of  and a minimum barometric pressure of .
* 12:00 UTC at The JMA reports that Typhoon Mawar (Two) has intensified into a very strong typhoon.
May 26
* 00:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Super Typhoon Mawar (Two) has reached its peak intensity of  and a minimum barometric pressure of .
May 27
* 00:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Super Typhoon Mawar (Two) has weakened into a Category 4-equivalent typhoon on the SSHWS.
May 28
* 00:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Typhoon Mawar (Two) has weakened into a Category 3-equivalent typhoon on the SSHWS.
May 29
* 12:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Typhoon Mawar (Two) has weakened into a Category 2-equivalent typhoon on the SSHWS.
May 30
* 00:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Typhoon Mawar (Two) has weakened into a Category 1-equivalent typhoon on the SSHWS.
May 31
* 00:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Typhoon Mawar (Two) has weakened into a tropical storm.
*18:00 UTC at The JMA reports that Typhoon Mawar (Two) has weakened into a severe tropical storm.
June
June 2
* 00:00 UTC at The JMA reports that Severe Tropical Storm Mawar (Two) has weakened into a tropical storm.
June 3
* 00:00 UTC at The JMA reports that Tropical Storm Mawar (Two) has weakened into a low.
* 03:00 UTC at The JTWC reports that Tropical Storm Mawar (Two) has weakened into an extratropical cyclone.
* 12:00 UTC at The JMA last notes the low, formerly named Mawar.
